qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Commodity digital used-car merchant with no pricing power over market bid-ask spreads. Gross profit per unit is thin (~€1,000-€1,500), and historical 5-year GAAP ROIC has been negative due to continuous operating losses post-IPO.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat Archetype None & ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Commodity used-car trading platform operating in a fragmented, highly competitive market with razor-thin gross profit margins per unit, working-capital and inventory financing intensity, and negative multi-year historical ROIC.
qualitative.evidence: Reported cumulative net losses from 2021 through 2023 (-€418M in 2021, -€275M in 2022, -€130M in 2023), reaching marginal net income (~€21M) only in 2024. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is negative. High inventory holding risk and reliance on asset-backed debt facilities.
